newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA'S VOLGA-DNEPR EXPANDS PASSENGER SERVICE.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA'S VOLGA-DNEPR EXPANDS PASSENGER SERVICE.

text.p: Russian cargo airline AO Volga-Dnepr has launched weekly passenger service between Volga-region Ulyanovsk and Black Sea resort Sochi, a company spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Anna Krasnova said the company had been operating Yakovlev Yak-40 aircraft on the route, which has a stopover in Saratov, since the end of July.
"This is our third scheduled domestic route," Krasnova said.
In April, Volga-Dnepr began weekly flights from Ulyanovsk, where it is based, to St Petersburg via Nizhny Novgorod on Yak-40s. It has operated daily Ulyanovsk-Moscow service since last year.
Volga-Dnepr also operates 12 cargo planes -- seven Antonov An-124s, one An-12, one An-32 and three Ilyushin Il-76TDs.
